'''''Vriesea splendens''''', or '''flaming sword''', is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Bromeliaceae]], subfamily [[Tillandsioideae]].  Native to [[Trinidad]], eastern [[Venezuela]] and the [[Guianas]]<ref name=y>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=272140 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>Hokche, O., Berry, P.E. & Huber, O. (eds.) (2008). Nuevo Catálogo de la Flora Vascular de Venezuela: 1-859. Fundación Instituto Botánico de Venezuela.</ref><ref>Funk, V. A., P. E. Berry, S. Alexander, T. H. Hollowell & C. L. Kelloff. 2007. Checklist of the Plants of the Guiana Shield (Venezuela: Amazonas, Bolivar, Delta Amacuro; Guyana, Surinam, French Guiana). Contributions from the United States National Herbarium 55: 1–584</ref><ref>Smith, L.B. & R. J. Downs. 1977. Tillandsioideae (Bromeliaceae), Part II. Flora Neotropica, Monograph 14(2): 663–1492</ref> these plants were introduced to [[Europe]] in 1840.  This species of ''[[Vriesea]]'' features smooth-margined foliage with brown bands growing in a rosette, usually producing a bright red inflorescence in a flattened spike. It is a recipient of the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref name = RHSPF>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/19052/Vriesea-splendens/Details | title = '' Vriesea splendens'' | website = www.rhs.org | publisher = Royal Horticultural Society | access-date = 5 March 2021}}</ref>

It is sometimes considered a synonym of ''[[Lutheria splendens]]''.<ref name=powo>{{cite web |title=''Vrisea splendens'' |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:126211-1 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Royal Botanical Gardens Kew |access-date=4 December 2018}}</ref>

The Bromeliad Cultivar Register lists a number of cultivars of ''V. splendens''.<ref name=bsi>{{cite web |title=Bromeliad Cultivar Register |url=http://registry.bsi.org/index.php |website=registry.bsi.org |publisher=Bromeliad Society International |access-date=4 December 2018}}</ref>
